# Security at Twelve Labs

Twelve Labs is a pioneering research and product company dedicated to revolutionizing video understanding. Our mission is to empower developers with the most advanced multimodal foundation models, providing them with the ultimate video understanding platform.

Security and reliability are paramount at Twelve Labs. We prioritize the protection of our users' data and systems by implementing robust security measures and adhering to industry best practices.

- Unique account authentication enforced

- Unique network system authentication enforced

- Confidentiality Agreement acknowledged by contractors
